an5.4:1.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing five qualities, a bhikkhu is deposited in hell as if brought there.
an5.4:1.3: Here, a bhikkhu is devoid of faith, morally shameless, morally reckless, lazy, and unwise.
an5.4:1.4: Possessing these five qualities, a bhikkhu is deposited in hell as if brought there.
an5.4:2.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing five other qualities, a bhikkhu is deposited in heaven as if brought there.
an5.4:2.3: Here, a bhikkhu is endowed with faith, has a sense of moral shame, has moral dread, and is energetic and wise.
an5.4:2.4: Possessing these five qualities, a bhikkhu is deposited in heaven as if brought there.”
